supporting_news.title: Jio Platforms' IPO-linked inflows boost rupee; elevated oil prices spur caution
supporting_news.summary: The Indian rupee experienced a notable increase as Jio Platforms' IPO attracted significant foreign investments. Despite this strength, rising oil prices raised concerns among traders about the rupee's sustainability. The rupee closed at 94.46 against the dollar, with earlier gains trimmed by higher Brent crude oil prices. Analysts suggest that the upcoming RBI monetary policy might influence future exchange rates.

supporting_news.title: Global Market: UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September, boosting rate hike bets
supporting_news.summary: UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August, exceeding expectations as higher fuel prices linked to the Iran war add to price pressures. Sticky services and core inflation strengthen expectations of a potential Bank of England rate hike.
